systems.Great Wall Generator: This is a **Generator.** Its effect **cannot** be conferred to another unit via the *Generator* *Ship* system. A model with a Great Wall Generator may create [[systems:Great Walls]], defending itself and other models from enemy munitions.
systems.Great Walls:
Great Wall Generators create Energy Walls through [[systems:Great Wall Networks]].

The builder can identify which units have **Great Wall Generator,** but it does not track table positions. The actual 7” links, Network membership, and Wall Strength must be resolved during play.
systems.Great Wall Networks:
While a model with **Great Wall Generator** is within **7”** of another friendly model that also has **Great Wall Generator** and the same **Positional Trait,** an **Energy Wall** is generated between the two models. It is a straight line drawn between their **Centre Points.**

Multiple models with **Great Wall Generator** can connect to one another in a Great Wall Network. The number of models in the Network determines the Energy Wall's **Strength.** The maximum Wall Strength of a single Network is equal to the highest **Mass** rating of any model connected to it. A single model can generate multiple Energy Walls if it is within **7”** of multiple eligible models.

Whenever an enemy unit makes an **Attack** action, trace a straight line from the Centre Point of each **Participating** model to the Centre Point of the **Initial Target.** For each line that passes through an Energy Wall, or that targets a model which is itself generating an Energy Wall, add **Standard Counters** equal to the Energy Wall's Strength to the **Resistance Roll.** If the Energy Wall is generated by models of a different Positional Trait to the Initial Target, it provides no benefit.

If a line passes through multiple Energy Walls, only the Energy Wall with the highest Strength is counted. Attack actions made with **Assault, Bomb,** or **Submerged** weapons, or weapons with the **Indirect** quality, ignore Energy Walls.

A model must actually have **Great Wall Generator** to create an Energy Wall; this effect cannot be shared through **Generator Ship.** A model carrying **Great Wall Generator** does not gain additional Standard Counters unless there is at least one other model in its Great Wall Network.
systems.Guardian Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

At the start of each **Activation Phase,** this model contributes **X Action Dice** to its Admiral's [[systems:Guardian Pool]].

If there is at least one die in the Guardian Pool when this model is targeted by an **Attack** action, its Admiral can declare that they will **Employ Guardian Generators.** They cannot do so against an Attack action made with **Assault** or **Submerged** weapons, or against anything that is not an Attack action, such as **Breaching Drill** or **Raking Strike.**

When an Admiral Employs Guardian Generators, they immediately spend Action Dice from the Guardian Pool. They must spend at least one, and the maximum number they can spend is equal to this model's **Defences** rating.

Each die spent this way is removed from the Guardian Pool and added to the **Resistance Pool** as a **Bonus Die.** In addition, when making this Resistance Roll, the Admiral can re-roll any **Blank** results.

Guardian Generators are Systems. If a model has one or more **System Failure** effects, it contributes no Action Dice to the Guardian Pool at the start of the Activation Phase. If it has one or more System Failure effects when targeted by an Attack action, it cannot Employ Guardian Generators.
systems.Guardian Pool:
The Crown Admiral has a pool of Action Dice called the **Guardian Pool.** Dice can be added to or removed from this pool over the course of a game. It should be kept to one side of the Play Area, near the Admiral's Victory & Valour deck.

At the start of each Round's **Activation Phase,** each model in the Play Area with **Guardian Generator (X)** adds **X Action Dice** to its Admiral's Guardian Pool.

Action Dice are used and removed from this pool as described in **Guardian Generator (X)** and **Guardian Surge (X).** In the **Clean Up** step of the **End Phase,** each die remaining in the Guardian Pool is discarded.
systems.Guardian Surge:
This model's unit can make a **Guardian Surge** as a **Special Action.** Only models with this System can **Participate** in this Action.

Each Participating model adds **X Action Dice** to its Admiral's [[systems:Guardian Pool]].
systems.Heavy Shield Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

Each model in this unit gains a **+1** Modifier to its **Armour** rating when it is the **Initial** **Target** of an **Attack** action.

This has no effect against attacks made with **Assault** or **Submerged** **Weapons.** It also has no effect against the Breaching Drill or Raking Strike properties.
systems.Hoved Targeting Array:
When a weapon in this unit with the *Barrage* quality **Contributes** to an **Attack** action, its Admiral can choose to use the weapon's **Standard** **Range** **Firepower** value in place of its **Extreme** **Range,** even if that weapon does not have an Extreme Range Firepower value.

In addition, if a model in this unit Participates in an Attack action at any Range, and all Contributing weapons have the *Barrage* quality, its **Visibility** cannot be **Hampered** or **Obscured.**
systems.Hydrophone Relay: **Attack** actions targeting enemy models within **10”** of this model never count their **Visibility** as **Hampered** or **Obscured.**
systems.Interphase Generator:
This is a **Generator.** Its effect **cannot** be conferred to another unit via the *Generator* *Ship* system.

If at least half the models in a unit have an Interphase Generator, that unit can use [[systems:Interphasing]].
systems.Interphasing:
If **at least half** the models in a unit have an **Interphase Generator,** its Admiral can declare that it will **Interphase** at the end of its **Consolidation Step.** Mark the unit with a **Special Effect** token. All models in the unit are Interphasing until the start of the unit's next **Action Step.**

In the subsequent Round, an Admiral must Activate any Interphasing units in their Force before they Activate any units that are not Interphasing.

An Interphasing model cannot be targeted by any Actions, rules, or effects, and cannot gain **Damage, Critical Damage,** or **Disorder** by any means. It cannot **Block Visibility** though it can still **Obscure** as normal. Its Properties and Systems other than **Interphase Generator** are ignored. **Surface** models can **Pass Through** an Interphasing model, but if they do, they gain **1** level of Disorder.

In an Interphasing unit's **Movement Step,** each model's **Maximum Speed** is doubled. They treat all **Terrain Features** and **Environmental Features** as **Open Water,** can Pass Through all other models, and are unaffected by Markers of any kind. They cannot **Come About,** but at the end of the move they can freely rotate around their Centre Point to face any direction. No model can end its move in contact with a Terrain Feature, model, or Marker.

At the end of the Movement Step, remove the Special Effect token. Each other model, friend or foe, that one or more models in the active unit Passed Through gains **1** level of Disorder.

In the subsequent Action Step, the unit's **Action Limit** is reduced to **1.** Weapons in the unit with **Torrent (X)** reduce X to **1** until the end of the Activation.

A unit cannot Interphase again in its Consolidation Step if it was Interphased at the start of its Activation.
systems.Langsam Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

As a **Special** **Action,** this model's unit can **Slow** an enemy unit, provided it is **Visible.** Only models with a *Langsam* *Generator* can **Participate** in this Action.

When making this Action, the active Admiral chooses an enemy model within **10”** of a Participating model to be the **Main** **Target.** They then roll a number of **Action Dice** equal to the number of Participating models, select the die of their choice, and resolve the corresponding result from the table below.

**Action** **Result** **Dice**

The Main Target suffers **1** **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.**

In addition, the Main Target's unit is **Slowed** (as described below).

The Main Target suffers **1** **Damage.**

In addition, the Main Target's unit is **Slowed** (as described below).

The Main Target's unit is **Slowed** (as described below).

Each Participating model suffers a *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.**

To show that a unit is Slowed, mark it with a **Generator** **Effect** token.

While a unit is Slowed, its **Action** **Limit** has a **-1** Modifier, and its **Maximum Speed** is reduced to its **Minimum** **Speed.**

At the end of the unit's next Activation, it stops being Slowed and the Generator Effect token is removed.
systems.Lateral Engines:
At the start of its **Movement** **Step,** before moving, this model can move up to X” without changing its facing. This is a free move and does not count towards the model's **Minimum** **Speed,** or against its **Maximum** **Speed.** The direction of this free move must be within its **Port** or **Starboard** arc. The entirety of this free move must be made in the same direction.

A model with a *Navigation* *Lock* **Critical Damage Effect** cannot use this System, nor can a model making a **Vanguard** **Move.** Additionally, while this model is **Limping,** halve X”, rounding up.
systems.Logistical Support: If, in the **Draw** **Cards** step of the **Ready** **Phase,** at least one model with this System is in the Play Area, the controlling Admiral increases their **Hand** **Limit** by 1.
systems.Long-Range Coordination: If at least one model with this System is in the Play Area, the controlling Admiral can re-roll any **Blank** results when making a **Reserve** **Roll.**
systems.Magma Cast Generator:
This is a **Generator.** Its effect **cannot** be conferred to another unit via the *Generator* *Ship* system.

This model's unit can use [[systems:Magma Casting]] to make a [[systems:Magma Sear Special Action]].
systems.Magma Casting:
A unit containing one or more models with **Magma Cast Generator** can make a **Magma Sear** Special Action. Only models with **Magma Cast Generator** can Participate.

Magma Sear uses [[systems:Magma Formations]] and is resolved through the [[systems:Magma Sear Special Action]] sequence.

**Magma Tower Generator** has its own system entry and is intentionally not treated as **Magma Cast Generator** by the builder.
systems.Magma Formations: A **Magma Formation** is a special type of **Terrain Feature.** Magma Formations follow the rules for **Icebergs,** but are treated as having an **Armour** rating of **5** instead of **3.**
systems.Magma Sear Special Action:
When a unit makes a **Magma Sear** action, resolve the following process.

**1. Nominate Participating Models.** The active Admiral nominates any number of models in the active unit that will **Participate** in the action. A model can only Participate if it has a **Magma Cast Generator.**

**2. Make the Magma Sear Roll.** Roll a number of **Action Dice** equal to the number of Participating models. If any Participating model has the ***Capital*** trait, roll **1** additional die. Then choose one die and discard the others. This die determines the **Magma Mass** rating and **Magma Eruption** effects. If every die is **Blank,** the action ends immediately.

**Exploding Strike:** Magma Mass **1** or **2;** Magma Eruption **1 Damage** and **1 Disorder.**

**Strike:** Magma Mass **1;** Magma Eruption **1 Damage** and **1 Disorder.**

**Counter:** Magma Mass **1;** Magma Eruption **1 Disorder.**

**3. Create or Expand a Magma Formation.** The active Admiral chooses one option. To create a new Magma Formation, place a Magma Formation in the **Play Area** with a **Mass** rating that matches the Magma Mass result. It must be within **15”** of at least one Participating model, and cannot be placed in contact with another Terrain Feature, within **1”** of a model, or within **1”** of a Marker. To expand an existing Magma Formation, choose an existing Magma Formation within **15”** of at least one Participating model. Its Mass is increased by the Magma Mass result, to a maximum of **4.** If possible, replace it with a larger appropriate terrain piece so the original would be wholly within the new piece. The replacement cannot be placed in contact with another Terrain Feature, model, or Marker. If it cannot be placed, or no suitable piece is available, mark the Formation with a **Damage** token to show its new Mass.

**4. Resolve Magma Eruptions.** Each model, friend or foe, within a number of inches equal to the **Mass** of the newly Created or Expanded Magma Formation becomes the Target of a **Magma Eruption.** Each Target suffers the effects listed by the chosen Magma Sear result.
systems.Magma Tower Generator:
This is a **Generator.** Its effect **cannot** be conferred to another unit via the *Generator* *Ship* system.

This model's unit can make a [[systems:Magma Sear Special Action]], with a slight alteration: when making the **Magma Sear Roll,** roll **4 Action Dice** instead of **1,** and do not add any additional dice for the ***Capital*** trait. In addition, if an **Exploding Strike** is chosen, its **Magma Eruption** deals **2 Damage** and **1 Disorder** instead of the usual effects.
systems.Magnetic Accelerator Tubes: In the **Choose** **SRS** **Mission** step of an **SRS** **Launch** in which this model is **Participating,** any SRS Tokens launched from this model can be allocated to a unit or Marker that is within **40”** of this model, instead of the usual **30”.**
systems.Magnetic Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

If a model in this unit is targeted by an **Attack** action involving **Aerial,** **Assault,** or **Submerged** **Weapons,** or an **Attack Run** mission, convert any **Heavy Strikes** in the **Resistance Roll** to **Heavy** **Counters** at the start of the **Count** **Hits** step.

In addition, if a model in this unit moves into **Proximity** with a **Minefield** **marker,** it can gain **1** level of **Disorder** to attempt to **Repel** the mines. If it does, roll an **Action** **Die.**

If a **Blank** is rolled, the Minefield is **Triggered** as normal. On any other result, remove the Marker from the Play Area and, at the end of the model's move, place it within **3”** of the moving model, wholly within its Fore Arc. If this brings the Minefield marker into contact with another model, that model immediately counts as Triggering it.
systems.Mine Sweeper:
As a **Special** **Action,** this model's unit can perform **Mine** **Clearance.** Only models with this System, and within **5”** of a **Minefield** marker, may **Participate.**

The controlling Admiral rolls **X** **Action Dice** for each Participating model. For each **Exploding Strike** rolled, they can choose to **Clear** a **Minefield** marker that is within **5”** of at least one Participating model.

In addition, if a model in this unit moves into **Proximity** with a **Minefield** **marker,** it can gain **1** level of **Disorder** to attempt to **Repel** the mines. If it does, roll an **Action** **Die.**

If a **Blank** is rolled, the Minefield is **Triggered** as normal. On any other result, remove the Marker from the Play Area and, at the end of the model's move, place it within **3”** of the moving model, wholly within its Fore Arc. If this brings the Minefield marker into contact with another model, that model immediately counts as Triggering it.
systems.Mirage Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

When a model in this unit is chosen as the **Initial** **Target** of an **Attack** action, and it is not within **10”** of any **Participating** models, its Admiral can declare that they will **Raise** **Refractive** **Fields** before the **Action Roll** is made. They cannot do this if this model has **3** levels of **Disorder.**

If they do so, their opponent must re-roll any **Standard Strikes** in the Action Roll. If no Participating models are within **30”** When the **Action Roll** is made, they must also re-roll any **Heavy** **Strikes.**

After the Attack action has been fully resolved, this model gains **1** level of **Disorder.**
systems.Mirage Projector Array:
When a friendly model within **7”** of this model is chosen as the **Initial** **Target** of an **Attack** action, its Admiral can use this system to grant that model the *Mirage* *Generator* system for the duration of the action, even if the target model has a *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.** They cannot do this if this model has **3** levels of **Disorder.**

After the Attack action has been fully resolved, ***this*** model gains **1** level of **Disorder,** as detailed in the *Mirage* *Generator* rules, instead of the target model.
systems.Naval Shield Amplifier: When making a **Resistance Roll** for this model, or a friendly model with the same Positional Trait within **10”** of this model, the controlling Admiral can re-roll **Blanks.**
systems.Null-Clone Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

This model's unit can **Engage** **Null-Clone** **Generators** as a **Special** **Action.** Only models with this System can **Participate** in this Action.

When this Action is made, each enemy model within **5”** of a Participating model gains a *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect,** unless it already has one. For every *System* *Failure* inflicted in this way, the active Admiral can remove a *System* *Failure* from a Participating model, or another friendly model within **10”** of a Participating model.
systems.Overthrusters:
When this model uses its *Boosted* *Propulsion* *(+X”)* system, mark it with a **Special** **Effect** token to show that it is at **Full** **Thrust.**

While a model is at Full Thrust, it benefits from the effects of the **Unconventional** **Target** rule, even if it is not an ***Airborne*** unit.

If a model at **Full** **Thrust** suffers a *Navigation* *Lock* *or* *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect,** it immediately ceases to be at Full Thrust and the Special Effect token is removed. Otherwise, the Token is removed in the **Clean Up** step of the **End** **Phase.**
systems.Platform Transport:
Once per game, during the **Deploy** **Reserves** step of the **Ready** **Phase,** this model's Admiral may deploy a single ***Union*** ***Platform*** model with a **Mass** rating of **3** or below within **2”** of this unit.

This is a free model and does not have to be chosen during **Force** **Selection.**
systems.Portal Accelerator Array: This model has additional options when manipulating portals. See [[systems:Portal Accelerator Arrays]], [[systems:Accelerated Weaving]], and [[systems:Imploding a Portal]].
systems.Portal Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

This model is a **Portal Manipulator** and uses [[systems:Portal Technology]]. It can [[systems:Weaving a Portal]] in the **Launch Phase,** and can [[systems:Shifting a Portal]] and/or [[systems:Closing a Portal]] as **Special Actions** during its Activation.
systems.Portal Technology:
Sultanate units with **Portal Generators** can place **Portal markers** in the Play Area and use them for movement, attacks, and special actions.

See [[systems:Portal Limits]], [[systems:Portal Markers]], [[systems:Manipulating Portals]], and [[systems:Utilising Portals]].
systems.Portal Limits:
The maximum number of **Portal** markers allowed in the Play Area is the **Portal Limit,** which depends on the Engagement Scale: **Small Engagement 4, Medium Engagement 6, Large Engagement 8.**

If both Admirals can create Portals, this limit applies to each Admiral separately.
systems.Portal Markers:
Portals are represented by **Portal markers**. A Portal marker is treated as having a **Mass** of **3,** and can **Block** or **Obscure Visibility** in the same way as a model.

Each Portal marker belongs to the Admiral who placed it. Once in play, it is available for that Admiral's use only, and only that Admiral may remove it unless a rule says otherwise.

**Colliding with Portal Markers.** ***Airborne*** and ***Underwater*** models can **Pass Through** a Portal marker. ***Surface*** models can **Move Through** Portal markers. At the end of a Surface model's Move, it gains **1** level of **Disorder** for each Portal marker it moved through. For each of those Portal markers, roll a number of **Action Dice** equal to the model's **Mass** rating. If one or more dice show a **Heavy Strike** or **Exploding Strike,** the Portal collapses and the marker is removed. If the model's Move ends touching a Portal marker, the marker is removed automatically. The model still gains Disorder for that marker, even if it did not fully move through it.
systems.Manipulating Portals:
A model with a **Portal Generator** system is a **Portal Manipulator.** It can be used to [[systems:Weaving a Portal]] in the **Launch Phase,** and can [[systems:Shifting a Portal]] or [[systems:Closing a Portal]] as **Special Actions** during its Activation.

A model with a **System Failure** Critical Damage Effect does not count as a Portal Manipulator.

Some Portal Manipulator models are equipped with [[systems:Portal Accelerator Arrays]], improving their portal actions.
systems.Portal Accelerator Arrays: Some Portal Manipulator models are equipped with a **Portal Accelerator Array.** This improves the model's ability to [[systems:Weaving a Portal]] through [[systems:Accelerated Weaving]], and allows it to optionally [[systems:Imploding a Portal]] when it would close one.
systems.Weaving a Portal:
During the **Launch Phase,** the controlling Admiral can nominate a unit containing at least one **Portal Manipulator** model, as if it were a **Carrier** unit, to **Weave a Portal.** If a Carrier unit contains a Portal Manipulator, it can be chosen twice in the Launch Phase: once to Weave a Portal, and once to resolve an **SRS Launch.**

When a unit Weaves a Portal, choose a Portal Manipulator model in the unit to be the **Weaver,** then place a Portal marker within **10”** of that model. This distance is increased by **10”** for each additional Portal Manipulator model in the unit, not including the Weaver.

A Portal marker cannot be placed within **Proximity** of a ***Surface*** model, **Terrain Feature,** another **Marker,** or overlapping an ***Airborne*** or ***Underwater*** model.

A unit cannot Weave a Portal if there are already Portal markers in the Play Area equal to its Admiral's [[systems:Portal Limits]].
systems.Accelerated Weaving: If the nominated Weaver has a **Portal Accelerator Array,** its Admiral can either place up to **2 Portal markers** following the standard rules, or place a single Portal marker up to **20”** away from the Weaver, plus **10”** for each additional **Portal Manipulator** model in the unit. Those additional models do not need to have Portal Accelerator Arrays.
systems.Shifting a Portal:
A unit that contains at least one **Portal Manipulator** model can **Shift a Portal** as a **Special Action** during its Activation. Only Portal Manipulator models can **Participate**.

The active Admiral chooses a Portal marker anywhere in the Play Area and repositions it within **10”** of its current position. This distance is not increased by having more than one Portal Manipulator in the unit.

The Portal marker cannot be repositioned within **Proximity** of a ***Surface*** model, **Terrain Feature,** another **Marker,** or overlapping an ***Airborne*** or ***Underwater*** model.
systems.Closing a Portal:
A unit that contains at least one **Portal Manipulator** model can **Close a Portal** as a **Special Action** during its Activation. Only Portal Manipulator models can **Participate**.

The active Admiral chooses a Portal marker anywhere in the Play Area. Every model, friend or foe, within **3”** of the marker immediately gains **1** level of **Disorder,** then the marker is removed from play.
systems.Imploding a Portal:
If at least one **Portal Manipulator** model in the unit is equipped with a **Portal Accelerator Array,** its Admiral can choose to **Implode** a Portal instead of Closing it normally.

Nominate a model in the active unit with a Portal Accelerator Array and choose a Portal marker within **20”** of that model. Make a **Crew Check** for the nominated model.

If the check fails, every model, friend or foe, within **3”** of the chosen marker immediately gains **1** level of **Disorder,** then the marker is removed from play.

If the check passes, the nominated model gains **1, 2,** or **3** levels of Disorder, chosen by the active Admiral. If this would take the model above **3** Disorder, it only counts as gaining enough levels to bring it to **3.** Then every model, friend or foe, within **3”** of the chosen Portal marker suffers **Damage** equal to the amount of Disorder gained by the nominated model, and gains **1 Disorder.** Finally, the marker is removed from play.
systems.Utilising Portals:
Many Sultanate units can **Deploy, Attack,** and **Depart** through Portals.

See [[systems:Deploying Through a Portal]], [[systems:Attacking Through a Portal]], and [[systems:Departing Through a Portal]].
systems.Deploying Through a Portal:
When a Sultanate ***Surface*** unit arrives from **Reserve,** it can **Deploy through a Portal** as long as no model in the unit has a **Mass** rating greater than **3.**

The unit's Admiral nominates a Portal marker in the Play Area, then deploys the unit so that each model is within **5”** of the chosen marker, and the chosen marker is in each model's **Aft** arc. The unit is **not** marked with an **Incoming** status token.

A model that Deploys from a Portal marker cannot be placed within **Proximity** of a Terrain Feature or a model in another unit.
systems.Attacking Through a Portal:
When a Sultanate ***Surface*** unit makes an **Attack** action, its Admiral can declare that it will Attack through a Portal marker. They must nominate one Portal marker in the Play Area as the **Entry Portal,** and another Portal marker as the **Exit Portal.**

Models in the unit can only **Participate** if the Entry Portal is within **7”** and **Visible** to them. A weapon can only **Contribute** if the Entry Portal is in one of its **Targeting Arcs.**

The attack's **Range** is measured from the **Initial Target** to the Exit Portal. When determining Visibility, trace lines from the centre of the Exit Portal instead of from an attacking model.

The Portal always counts as **Obscuring** each Participating model's Visibility. As a result, the opposing Admiral always adds at least **3 Bonus Dice** to the Resistance Roll for each Participating model.
systems.Departing Through a Portal:
At the start of a Sultanate ***Surface*** unit's **Movement Step,** its Admiral can declare that the unit will **Depart through a Portal.**

If, during that step, a model from the unit with a **Mass** rating of **3** or less moves into contact with a Portal marker, and the point of contact is in the model's **Fore** arc, the model is removed from play and set aside. **No Collision** is resolved.

At the end of the Movement Step, any models in the unit that are still in the Play Area are **Abandoned.** The rest of the unit returns to its Admiral's **Reserve,** and can return to the Play Area in the **Ready Phase** of a subsequent **Round.**
systems.Power Transfer Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

When making an **Action Roll** or **Resistance Roll** for another ***Enlightened*** model within **4”** of this model, its Admiral can add **3** **Bonus Dice** to the Pool. If they do so, this model gains **1** level of **Disorder.** If it already has **3** Disorder, it suffers **1** **Damage** instead.
systems.Priority Signals:
When attempting to enact a **Valour** **Effect,** but before the opposing Admiral declares whether or not they will attempt to **Deny** it, this model's Admiral can declare that they are using **Priority** **Signals,** provided they have at least one model with this System in the **Play** **Area.**

If they do so, the **Value** of the **Valour** **card** is treated as being 2 higher, to a maximum of 12.

An Admiral can only use Priority Signals once per Round, even if they have multiple models with this System.
systems.Release the Tethers:
A unit containing one or more models with **Tethered Bangpae** can make a **Special Action** to **Release the Tethers.**

When it does, remove all Tethered Bangpae from models in the unit, then set them up as a new **Bangpae Explosive Automata** unit. Each model in the new unit must be placed within **1”** of the active unit, and no model can be placed within **1”** of another unit, excluding the active unit.

The new unit is marked with an **Activated** status token. It is now a full unit within the Force, with the Bangpae treated as models instead of Tokens.
systems.Special SRS Missions:
Some ORBAT SRS types have **Special SRS Missions** instead of the normal SRS mission list.

**Alliance Talon Rotors** can choose [[systems:Terminator Assault Mission]], [[systems:Ground Support Mission]], or [[systems:Supply Drop Mission]]. They cannot be given **Attack Run, Air Support,** or **Mine Clearance** missions.

**Union Talon Autogyros** can choose [[systems:Talon Assault Mission]], [[systems:Ground Support Mission]], or [[systems:Supply Drop Mission]]. They cannot be given **Attack Run, Air Support,** or **Mine Clearance** missions.
systems.Talon Rotor Special SRS Missions:
An **SRS Stack** containing one or more **Alliance Talon Rotor** tokens can be given the following missions:

- [[systems:Terminator Assault Mission|Terminator Assault]]
- [[systems:Ground Support Mission|Ground Support]]
- [[systems:Supply Drop Mission|Supply Drop]]

They cannot be given **Attack Run, Air Support,** or **Mine Clearance** missions.
systems.Talon Autogyro Special SRS Missions:
An **SRS Stack** containing one or more **Union Talon Autogyro** tokens can be given the following missions:

- [[systems:Talon Assault Mission|Talon Assault]]
- [[systems:Ground Support Mission|Ground Support]]
- [[systems:Supply Drop Mission|Supply Drop]]

They cannot be given **Attack Run, Air Support,** or **Mine Clearance** missions.
systems.Terminator Assault Mission:
Allocate the SRS Stack to an enemy ***Surface*** or ***Airborne*** unit within **25”** of the model from which it is launched. It is now **Assaulting** that unit. When this Mission is resolved, it has the potential to inflict highly targeted **Critical Damage** on models in the enemy unit.

To resolve it, first resolve an **Interception Attempt** if the target is **Supported** by an SRS Stack. After this, all SRS tokens in the enemy Stack are immediately discarded.

The active Admiral nominates enemy models as **Assault Targets,** up to the number of Talon Rotor tokens in the Stack. Then make a single **Action Roll** and a single **Resistance Roll,** regardless of the number of Assault Targets. The **Resolve Outcomes** step is skipped.

**Action Pool:** each Talon Rotor token adds Action Dice equal to its **Attack** rating.

**Resistance Pool:** each Assault Target adds dice equal to its **Defences** rating. Add **1 Bonus Die** for each **Escort** accompanying the target unit.

The active Admiral chooses an Assault Target and removes **Hits** from the Action Pool equal to the model's **Crew** rating. If this is not possible, the step ends. Otherwise, roll **2 Critical Damage Dice** and choose one Critical Damage Effect to inflict on that model. If both dice show the same result, the target also suffers **1 Damage.** Repeat while possible, but each Assault Target can only be chosen once. Then discard all SRS tokens in the Stack.
systems.Talon Assault Mission:
Allocate the SRS Stack to an enemy ***Surface*** or ***Airborne*** unit within **25”** of the model from which it is launched. It is now **Assaulting** that unit. When this Mission is resolved, it has the potential to inflict highly targeted **Critical Damage** on models in the enemy unit.

To resolve it, first resolve an **Interception Attempt** if the target is **Supported** by an SRS Stack. After this, all SRS tokens in the enemy Stack are immediately discarded.

The active Admiral nominates enemy models as **Assault Targets,** up to the number of Talon Autogyro tokens in the Stack. Then make a single **Action Roll** and a single **Resistance Roll,** regardless of the number of Assault Targets. The **Resolve Outcomes** step is skipped.

**Action Pool:** each Talon Autogyro token adds Action Dice equal to its **Attack** rating.

**Resistance Pool:** each Assault Target adds dice equal to its **Defences** rating. Add **1 Bonus Die** for each **Escort** accompanying the target unit.

The active Admiral chooses an Assault Target and removes **Hits** from the Action Pool equal to the model's **Crew** rating. If this is not possible, the step ends. Otherwise, the chosen model gains **1 Disorder** and suffers a **Critical Damage Effect** chosen by the active Admiral. Repeat while possible, but each Assault Target can only be chosen once. Then discard all SRS tokens in the Stack.
systems.Ground Support Mission:
Allocate the SRS Stack to a friendly **Landing Party** stack on a **Territory** within **25”** of the model from which it is launched. It is now **Approaching** that Territory.

When resolved, roll a number of **Action Dice** equal to the number of Talon Rotor or Talon Autogyro tokens in the Stack. If at least one **Strike** is rolled, add an additional Token to the Landing Party Stack. Then discard all tokens in the SRS Stack.
systems.Supply Drop Mission:
Allocate the SRS Stack to a friendly unit within **25”** of the model from which it is launched. It is now **Supplying** that unit.

When resolved, roll a number of **Action Dice** equal to the number of Talon Rotor or Talon Autogyro tokens in the Stack. For each **Strike** rolled, the active Admiral can choose a model in the unit. That model may immediately lose **1** level of **Disorder** or remove a **Depleted** status token. It may do this even if it would not otherwise be able to **Rally.** A model cannot be chosen more than once per Mission. Then discard all tokens in the SRS Stack.
systems.Physeter Constructs:
Some Enlightened rules allocate **Physeter Construct** tokens to units. These tokens can protect their unit or be launched to sabotage enemies.

See [[systems:Physeter Construct Tokens]], [[systems:Physeter Protection]], and [[systems:Physeter Sabotage]].
systems.Physeter Construct Tokens: A **Physeter Construct** token is a special kind of **Token** that can be allocated to a unit. A unit can never have more than **3** Physeter Construct tokens allocated to it.
systems.Physeter Protection:
The Admiral can **Unleash** one or more Physeter Construct tokens from a unit, removing them from play, to use **Physeter Protection.**

This can be done when the unit is the target of a **Boarding** action; an **Attack** action in which at least one **Assault** or **Submerged** weapon is **Contributing;** an **Attack Run** mission made by an SRS Stack containing at least one token with the **Underwater SRS** property; or [[systems:Physeter Sabotage]].

Add **2 Bonus Dice** to the **Resistance Roll** for each Physeter Construct token Unleashed.
systems.Physeter Sabotage:
A unit with one or more **Physeter Construct** tokens can make a **Special Action** to enact **Physeter Sabotage.**

Choose a target enemy ***Surface*** or ***Underwater*** model within **20”** of at least one model in the active unit, then **Unleash** one or more Physeter Construct tokens allocated to the active unit. Make an **Action Roll,** and the opposing Admiral makes a **Resistance Roll.**

**Action Pool:** each Unleashed Physeter Construct token adds **5 Action Dice**.

**Resistance Pool:** starts with dice equal to the target's **Defences** rating. Add **1 Bonus Die** for each **Escort** accompanying the target unit. If the target is accompanied by one or more SRS tokens with the **Underwater SRS** property, each one adds Bonus Dice equal to its **Support** rating.

**Success Threshold:** the target's **Armour** rating. If the target has a **Heavy Shield Generator,** the **+1 Modifier** to Armour is ignored.

For each **Success** scored, roll a **Critical Damage Die.** Each resulting **Critical Damage Effect** is inflicted on the target.
systems.Localised Anomaly Pool:
The Enlightened Admiral has a pool of **Action Dice** called the **Localised Anomaly Pool.** There are no dice in the pool at the start of the game, but some rules add dice to it. Action Dice added to the pool remain in it until a rule specifically states that they are removed.

If a rule instructs the Admiral to make an **Anomaly Roll,** roll all dice in the Localised Anomaly Pool, resolve the roll as instructed, then return the dice to the pool.

In addition to [[systems:Turbo Encabulation Jumps]], the following Systems interact with the Localised Anomaly Pool: **Callimachus Chrono-Lathe, Chrono Generator, Diophantus Chaos-Orb, Localised Anomaly Stabilisation Unit, Null-Clone Generator,** and **Recombination Nexus.**
systems.Turbo Encabulation Jumps:
Some rules allow a unit to attempt a **Turbo Encabulation Jump** as a **Special Action.** Only models with the **TED** system can **Participate.**

First, add **2 Action Dice** to the [[systems:Localised Anomaly Pool]], then make an **Anomaly Roll** for the unit. For each **Blank** scored, each Participating model gains **1** level of **Disorder.** If this would cause any model to gain a fourth level of Disorder, resolve a [[systems:Resolving a Botched Jump]]. Otherwise, resolve a [[systems:Resolving a Successful Jump]].
systems.Resolving a Botched Jump:
When a **Turbo Encabulation Jump** is **Botched,** the entire active unit, including any models that did not **Participate,** is removed from the **Play Area** and placed in **Reserve.**

The unit can attempt to return to the Play Area via a **Reserve Roll** in later Rounds. If the unit is still in Reserve at the end of the game, all remaining models are treated as **Abandoned.**
systems.Resolving a Successful Jump:
When a **Turbo Encabulation Jump** is not Botched, remove each **Participating** model from the Play Area, then return it to the Play Area no more than **1”** away from where it was. Models can be placed facing any direction, but cannot be placed within **Proximity** of an enemy model, and the unit must be in **Coherency** once all models have been placed.

After making a Turbo Encabulation Jump, a unit cannot make any more Actions in that **Action Step,** and does not count as having any unused Actions for the purpose of **Rallying** in the **Consolidation Step.**

When a unit makes an Encabulation Jump, SRS tokens allocated to the unit are left behind as though it had **Withdrawn**. Any other Tokens, except **Missing Targets,** move with the model or models as normal.
systems.Recombination Nexus:
This model's unit can **Reinforce Reality** as a **Special Action.** Only models with this System can **Participate**.

Each Participating model removes **X Action Dice** from its Admiral's [[systems:Localised Anomaly Pool]].
systems.Repair Facilities:
Models within **4”** of at least one friendly model with this System are in **Repair** **Range,** as long as they share the same **Positional** **Trait.** A model with this System always counts as being in Repair Range.

When making a **Repair** **Roll** for a model that is in Repair Range, add **X** **Bonus** **Dice.** If the roll would allow the unit to remove more **Critical** **Damage** **Effects** than it has allocated to it, **1** **Damage** is also removed from the model.
systems.Repulsion Field Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

When moving a model in this unit, its Admiral can declare that they will **Engage** **Repulsion** **Fields.**

For the duration of the model's move, it treats all **Terrain** **Features** as **Open** **Water,** and can **Pass** **Through** ***Surface*** models. It only counts as contacting a **Minefield** or **Wreck** marker if it ends its move in contact with the Marker.

At the end of its move, the model gains **1** level of Disorder. If it ends its move in contact with a **Terrain** **Feature,** it is immediately **Destroyed.**
systems.Sentinel Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

Before the **Action Roll** is made for an **Attack** action or **Attack Run** mission in which a model from this unit is the target, its Admiral can declare that they will activate its Sentinel Generator. They cannot do so if the model is targeted by an Attack made with **Assault,** **Bomb** or **Submerged** Weapons.

If a model's Sentinel Generator is activated, it cannot benefit from any other Generators during this Attack action or Attack Run mission. However, immediately before the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step of the Action Roll, its Admiral can remove **2** **Action Dice** of their choice from the roll.
systems.Shockwave Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

As a **Special** **Action,** this model's unit can emit a **Seismic** **Blast.** Only models with the System may **Participate.**

The active Admiral selects an enemy model within **10”** of all Participating models. They then make a **Shockwave** **Roll,** using a number of **Action Dice** equal to the combined **Mass** rating of all Participating models.

For each **Heavy Strike** or **Exploding Strike** that is rolled, the enemy model gains **1** level of **Disorder.**
systems.Shroud Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

When a model in this unit is the **Initial** **Target** of an **Attack** action, each Participating model's **Visibility** always counts as **Hampered** (as described in ***Environmental*** ***Features*** on page 117 of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook) unless it is within **5”** of the **Initial** **Target** and has the same **Positional** **Trait.**

In addition, when this model **Obscures** another model's Visibility during an Attack action, that model's Visibility will be both Hampered and Obscure
systems.Solex Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

When this unit makes an Attack action, its Admiral may declare **Thermal** **Agitation.**

For the duration of the Action, all **Contributing** weapons that have the *Solex* *(X)* quality use the Enhanced *Solex* *(X)* quality instead, retaining the same **X** value.

After the Action has been resolved, the active Admiral chooses one model in the unit with a Solex Generator. That model gains **1** **Disorder.** If it already has 3 levels of Disorder, it suffers **1** **Damage** instead.

If the Unit Benefit was granted by a model in a different unit - for example, a model with the *Generator* *Ship* system - that model gains Disorder instead.
systems.Storm Generator:
This is a **Generator** and grants the following **Unit** **Benefit:**

When a model in this unit is the **Initial** **Target** of an **Attack** action, or the **Target** of a **Boarding** action, the opposing Admiral must re-roll any **Heavy Strikes** in the **Action** **Roll.**

Additionally, at the end of this unit's Activation, each enemy model in **Proximity** of at least one model in the unit with this System gains **1** level of **Disorder.**
systems.Superior Void-Engine: When this unit, or a friendly unit within **10”,** makes a [[systems:Turbo Encabulation Jumps]], the controlling Admiral can choose to re-roll a single **Blank** result in the **Anomaly Roll.**
systems.Trident Generator:
This is a **Generator.**

This model's unit can **Flag** **a** **Target** as a **Special** **Action,** even if it is ***Underwater.*** Only models with a *Trident* *Generator* can **Participate** in this Action.

When making this Action, each Participating model can **Flag** a single enemy Surface or Underwater model within **20”.** Mark each Flagged model with a **Generator** **Effect** token.

Whenever a Flagged model is the Target of an **Attack** action made with **Submerged** **Weapons,** all **Standard** **Counters** in the **Action Roll** are converted to **Standard Strikes** at the start of the **Count** **Hits** step.

qualities.Aerial:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Aerial** **Weapons,** and can only **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if all Contributing weapons are also Aerial Weapons.

See ***Aerial*** ***Weapons*** on page 91 of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.
qualities.Agitation:
Each of this weapon's **Firepower** ratings is increased by an **Agitation** **Bonus.** This is equal to the **Mass** rating of the **Initial** **Target,** up to a maximum of X.

Firepower ratings of ‘-' cannot be increased in this way. However, Firepower ratings of **0** ***can*** be increased in this way.

***For** **example,** a weapon with the **Agitation** **(4)** quality has Firepower ratings of 0 / 2 / -. If the Initial Target has a Mass of 2, its Firepower ratings are increased to 2 / 4 / -. If the Initial Target has a Mass of 6, its Firepower ratings are increased to 4 / 6 / -.*
qualities.Alchemical:
After this **Attack** action is resolved, each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality inflicts **X** **Negative** **Effect** tokens on the **Initial** **Target.** These are **Ablaze** tokens. A model with a *Hazard* **Critical Damage Effect** cannot gain Ablaze tokens.

If at least one weapon Contributing to this Attack action also has the *Blast* *(X)* quality, any **Secondary** **Targets** that take at least **1** **Damage** also gain an Ablaze token.

If a model accumulates Ablaze tokens equal to or in excess of its **Mass** rating, all of its Ablaze tokens are removed and it immediately gains a *Hazard* Critical Damage Effect.

When making a **Repair** **Roll,** an Admiral can remove all Ablaze tokens from a model as though they were a single Critical Damage Effect.
qualities.All Around: When **Declaring** **Contributing Weapons** for an **Attack** action, this weapon can **Contribute** regardless of which **Targeting** **Arc** the **Initial** **Target** is in.
qualities.Arc:
***Before*** making the **Action Roll** for an **Attack** action, the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality.

If any die shows a *System* *Failure,* the **Initial** **Target** immediately suffers a single *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.**

If the Initial Target has already suffered a *System* *Failure* during this **Action** **Step,** this Quality has no effect.
qualities.Assault:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Assault** **Weapons,** and can only **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if all Contributing weapons are also Assault Weapons.

See ***Assault*** ***Weapons*** on page 91 of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.
qualities.Aquatic: An ***Underwater*** unit may make an **Attack** action if all **Contributing** weapons have this Quality, and the **Initial** **Target** is also an ***Underwater*** model.
qualities.Barrage:
If at least one weapon **Contributing** to an **Attack** action has this Quality, the Target's **Mass** rating is treated as being one point lower when resolving the **Under** **Fire** rule.

In addition, if all weapons **Contributing** to an **Attack** action have this Quality and the Target is an ***Airborne*** model, only **Standard Strikes** in the **Resistance Roll** are converted to **Standard** **Counters** by the **Unconventional** **Target** rule.
qualities.Blast:
After choosing a model to be the **Initial** **Target,** the active Admiral chooses a point on the model. Every other model (friend or foe) that is within **3”** of this point and shares a **Positional Trait** with the **Initial** **Target** is a **Secondary** **Target.**

After this **Attack** action has been resolved, the active Admiral makes a separate **Action Roll** for each Secondary Target. There is no Resistance Roll.

**Action** **X** **Action Dice** for each **Contributing** **Pool** weapon with this Quality.

**Success** The **Armour** rating of the **Secondary** **Threshold** **Target.**

For each **Success** scored in the Action Roll, the Secondary Target suffers **1** **Damage.**

*Note that any Properties or Weapon Qualities that apply against the Initial Target **do** **not** apply against Secondary Targets.*
qualities.Bomb:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Bomb** **Weapons,** and can only **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if all Contributing weapons are also Bomb Weapons.

See ***Bomb*** ***Weapons*** on page 91 of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.

In addition, if a Bomb Weapon is mounted on a model whose **Centre** **Point** passed through the Initial Target during the **Movement Step** of this Activation, each of its **Firepower** ratings are doubled.
qualities.Breach:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If one or more dice show a **Breach** result, the Initial Target suffers one **Critical Damage Effect** of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.
qualities.Celerity:
After this Attack has been resolved, the active Admiral can attempt to enact a **Special** **Valour** **Effect** with the active unit.

If the effect is successfully enacted, this unit can immediately make a **Follow-Up** **Attack.**

First, each model in this unit that has a weapon with this Quality can immediately Pivot and move up to **4”** straight forwards. Then, this unit makes another **Attack** action, which does not count towards its Action limit. Only weapons with this quality can **Contribute** to this action.

A unit can only make one Follow-Up Attack per Activation.
qualities.Coruscating:
This weapon cannot contribute to a normal **Attack** action. Instead this Admiral may declare that this model will fire a **Coruscating** **Beam,** a unique Action that can be considered an Attack action for the purpose of any other **Qualities** that this weapon may possess.

To do so, this Admiral must draw a **2** **cm** width line from the prow of this ship to the other side of the battlefield, ensuring the line is entirely within this weapon's **Targeting** **Arc(s).** Each **Surface** model (friend or foe) that this line crosses is a **Coruscating** **Target.**

*Note: the Warcradle measuring tool is roughly 2 cm wide, and works perfectly for plotting the course of your beam.*

The Admiral then rolls a number of **Action Dice** equal to the **Firepower** rating of this weapon at the relevant range band for each Coruscating Target.

The Target suffers **1** **Damage** for each **Standard Strike** and **2** **Damage** for each **Heavy Strike** and **Exploding** **Strike.**

If the Target suffers at least **1** Damage, it also gains **1** level of **Disorder.**

*Note: This is not a standard Attack action and so **Exploding Strikes** do not cause additional dice to be rolled and the **Under** **Fire** rule does not apply.*
qualities.Cruor:
After resolving an **Attack** action in which one or more weapons with this Quality **Contributed,** the active Admiral may attempt to enact a **Special** **Valour** **Effect** with the active unit.

If successful, each model within **10”** of the **Initial** **Target** gains **1** level of **Disorder,** unless they have the listed Trait.
qualities.Deathblow:
When declaring an **Attack** action with a unit that has at least one weapon with this Quality, they can announce that they will attempt a **Deathblow.**

After the **Declare** **Contributing Weapons** step, the Admiral makes a **Group** **Crew Check** for the **Participating** models. If the Check is passed then each weapon in the unit with this Quality doubles each of its **Firepower** ratings, but counts as having the *Intensive* quality.

*Note that a Deathblow can only be attempted with a unit that has at least two Actions remaining.*
qualities.Depth Charge: An *Underwater* model can be chosen as the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action, as long as all **Contributing** weapons have this Quality. A weapon with this Quality cannot Contribute to any Attack action in which an ***Airborne*** model is the Initial Target.
qualities.Devastating:
Each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality allows the active Admiral to **Convert** up to **X** **Heavy Strikes** in the **Action Roll** to **Exploding** **Strikes,** immediately after rolling the dice, ***before*** beginning the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step.

*Note: this quality directly opposes the Ablative Armour (X) property. See that property for details.*
qualities.Disruption:
If the Initial Target suffers at least **1** **Disorder** as a result of this action, it takes a Negative Effect token (unless it already has one). This is a **Disruption** token.

A model with a Disruption token has a **-1** **Crew** **Modifier,** and standard **Valour** **Effects** cannot be enacted upon it. **(Special** **Valour** **Effects** can be enacted upon it as normal.)

In the **Consolidation** **Step** of the model's next Activation, its Disruption token is removed.
qualities.Enhanced Solex: After the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step of an **Attack** action, each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality allows the active Admiral to convert up to **X** **Counters** in the Action Roll into equivalent **Strikes.** **(Standard** **Counters** become **Standard** **Strikes,** and **Heavy** **Counters** become **Heavy** **Strikes.)**
qualities.Gaseous:
If all weapons **Contributing** to an **Attack** action have this **Quality,** the Attack is considered **Gaseous.**

When resolving a Gaseous attack, each **Success** scored in the **Action Roll** inflicts **1** **Disorder** instead of **1** **Damage.**

If this would cause the Target to gain more than **3** levels of Disorder, then each excess point of Disorder inflicts **1** Damage instead. A Gaseous attack does not trigger the **Under** **Fire** rule. However any model suffering Damage as the result of a Gaseous attack automatically gains a *Hazard* **Critical** **Damage** token if it does not already have one.

*Note: Disorder **Spreads** as normal even when Damage is inflicted. Additionally, if the **Jade** **Fury** Battlefleet Bonus is in effect (see the Empire ORBAT), the target suffers **1** Damage for each excess point of Disorder and not 2.*
qualities.Guided: If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action is also being **Threatened** by a friendly **SRS** **stack,** increase each of this weapon's **Firepower** ratings by X. Firepower ratings that do not have a value are ***not*** increased.
qualities.Hazard:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this **Quality.** **If** **one** **or** **more** **dice** **show** **a** **Hazard** **result,** **the** **Initial** **Target** **suffers** **one** **Critical** Damage Effect of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.
qualities.High Velocity: At the start of the **Count** **Hits** step of this **Attack,** each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality allows the active Admiral to convert **X** **Heavy** **Counters** in the **Resistance Roll** to **Standard** **Counters.**
qualities.Homing: If at least half of the weapons **Contributing** to an **Attack** action have this Quality, the **Resistance Roll** does not gain any **Bonus Dice** for **Obscured** or **Hampered** Visibility.
qualities.Indirect:
This weapon does not need to confirm **Visibility** to the **Initial** **Target** to **Contribute** to an **Attack** action. However, for each Indirect weapon that Contributes to an Attack where Visibility to the Initial Target is **Blocked,** add **3** **Bonus Dice** to the **Resistance** **Roll.**

This weapon cannot Contribute to an Attack if the Initial Target is an ***Airborne*** model.
qualities.Indiscriminate:
If at least half of the weapons **Contributing** to an **Attack** action have this Quality, the **Resistance Roll** does not gain any **Bonus Dice** for **Obscured** or **Hampered** Visibility.

Additionally, after this Action has been resolved, roll an **Action** **Die** for each **Escort** token accompanying the target's unit. On any **Strike** result, the Token is immediately discarded.
qualities.Intensive: If at least one weapon with this Quality **Contributes** to an **Attack** action, the active unit counts as having spent an additional **Action.** If the unit does not have enough Actions remaining, weapons with this Quality cannot Contribute to the Action.
qualities.Invalid Target: This weapon cannot **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if the **Initial** **Target** has any of the listed **Traits.**
qualities.Kingslayer:
If the Initial Target of this Attack has an **Armour** rating of **5** or more, it is treated as having an Armour rating of **4** in the **Resolve** **Outcome** step. Once **X** **Successes** have been resolved, this Quality ceases to apply, and any remaining **Hits** are re-grouped accordingly.

If multiple **Contributing** weapons have this Quality, their **X** values are combined.
qualities.Leaping:
Weapons with this Quality may **Contribute** to **Attack** actions against targets with the *Elevated,* *Amphibious,* or *Landstrider* properties, or models with the *Descend* property that are **Surfacing,** even if they are not normally able to. Weapons with this Quality ignore the *Reinforced* *Waterline* property.

Additionally, if every **Contributing** weapon has this Quality, the unit's Admiral may attempt to enact a **Special** **Valour** **Effect.** If successful, the **Vulnerable** **Stern** rule applies to the Target, even if the **Participating** models are outside of the Target's Aft arc, and even if another rule would exempt it from Vulnerable Stern.
qualities.Limited:
After resolving this **Attack** action, each weapon with this Quality that **Contributed** to the action is **Depleted.** The model that the weapon is mounted on gains a **Depleted** status token. This weapon cannot Contribute to an Attack action if it is mounted on a model with the Depleted status.

At the end of the model's next Action Step, the Depleted status token is removed.
qualities.Mayhem:
If a model suffers at least **1** **Damage** from this Attack, it immediately gains **1** level of **Disorder.** This replaces the **Under** **Fire** rule, but any other rules that cause the target to gain Disorder still apply.

*If this attack also has the Blast (X) quality, this affects Secondary Targets as well as the Initial Target.*
qualities.Multiple Batteries:
This weapon may be selected to **Contribute** to an **Attack** action up to **X** times per **Activation,** instead of only once.

Each time it Contributes to an attack, the Target must be in a different **Targeting** **Arc** to one previously used in this Activation.
qualities.Navigation Lock:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If one or more dice show a **Navigation** **Lock** result, the Initial Target suffers one **Critical Damage Effect** of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.
qualities.Piercing:
In the **Resolve** **Outcome** step of this **Attack** action, the **Initial** **Target** suffers a **-1** Modifier to its **Armour** rating (to a minimum of 1) during the **Resolve** **Outcome** step. Once **X** **Successes** have been resolved, this Quality ceases to apply, and any remaining **Hits** are re-grouped accordingly.

If multiple **Contributing** weapons have this Quality, their **X** values are combined.
qualities.Precise:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral chooses a **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.**

After the Effect has been announced to the opposing Admiral, the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If at least one die matches the declared Effect, a single instance of that Effect is immediately applied to the Target.
qualities.Protective Fire:
When a model with this weapon is the target of an **Attack Run** mission, or of an **Attack** action in which at least one weapon with the *Barrage* quality is **Contributing,** it may perform **Protective** **Fire.**

Add a number of **Bonus Dice** to the **Resistance Roll** equal to the combined **X** **Values** of all weapons on the model with this Quality.
qualities.Powered: This weapon cannot **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if the model on which it is mounted has a *System* *Failure* **Critical** **Damage** **Effect.**
qualities.Rail:
*In the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step of the **Action Roll** for this **Attack** action, the first **X** **Exploding Strikes** cause **two** additional **Action Dice** to be rolled, instead of one.*

*If multiple **Contributing** weapons have this Quality, their **X** values are combined.*

*For example, the weapons Contributing to an attack have, in total, Rail (4). The initial Action Roll contains 3 Exploding Strikes, so they roll 6 additional dice (two for each Exploding Strike), scoring a further 2 Exploding Strikes. They roll 3 additional dice: two for the first Exploding Strike, but only one for the second as Rail no longer applies.*
qualities.Shredded Defences:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If one or more dice show **Shredded** **Defences** result, the Initial Target suffers one **Critical Damage Effect** of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.
qualities.Singular:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Singular** **Weapons.**

See ***Singular*** ***Weapons*** on page **92** of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.
qualities.Sky Strike:
If the Initial Target of this attack is an ***Airborne*** model, increase each of this weapon's **Firepower** ratings by X. Firepower ratings that do not have a value are *not* increased.

In addition, if all weapons **Contributing** to this attack have this quality, the **Unconventional** **Target** rule does not apply.
qualities.Solex: After the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step of an **Attack** action, each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality allows the active Admiral to convert up to **X** **Standard** **Counters** in the Action Roll into **Standard** **Strikes.**
qualities.Structural Failure:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If one or more dice show a **Structural** **Failure** result, the Initial Target suffers one **Critical Damage Effect** of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.

See ***Submerged*** ***Weapons*** on page **92** of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.
qualities.Submerged:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Submerged** **Weapons,** and can only **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if all Contributing weapons are also Submerged Weapons.

See ***Submerged*** ***Weapons*** on page **92** of the *Dystopian* *Wars* Rulebook.
qualities.Sympathetic Detonation:
When making an **Attack** action in which one or more weapons with this Quality is **Contributing,** at the start of the **Resolve** **Exploding Strikes** step, the active Admiral can discard one or more friendly **Scythe** **Fighter** **SRS** **tokens** that are attached to the Initial Target's unit.

For each token they discard, one **Heavy Strike** in the **Action** **roll** is converted to an **Exploding** **Strike.**
qualities.Synergy: For each additional weapon with this Quality (above one) that **Contributes** to this **Attack** action, increase each of those weapons' **Firepower** ratings by 1. Firepower ratings that do not have a value are not increased.
qualities.System Failure:
If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action suffers at least **1** **Damage,** the active Admiral rolls **X** **Critical Damage Dice** for each **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. If one or more dice show a **System** **Failure** result, the Initial Target suffers one **Critical Damage Effect** of that type.

This is a **Critical** **Damage** **Quality.** If multiple different Critical Damage Qualities apply to an Attack, the Admiral makes a separate roll for each one.
qualities.Torpedo: This weapon cannot **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if the **Initial** **Target** is within **5”** of this model.
qualities.Torrent:
Weapons with this **Special** **Attack** **Quality** are **Torrent** **Weapons,** and can only **Contribute** to an **Attack** action if all Contributing weapons are also Torrent Weapons.

See *Torrent* *Weapons* on page **92** of the **Dystopian** **Wars** Rulebook.
qualities.Tracer:
After resolving an **Attack** action in which one or more weapons with this **Quality** is **Contributing,** the **Initial** **Target** is **Marked.** Track this by placing a **Negative** **Effect** token on the **Initial** **Target.**

When ***any*** unit makes an Attack action that targets a Marked model, the active Admiral re-rolls any **Blanks** in the **Action** **Roll.**

Remove the Negative Effect token in the **Clean Up** step of the **End** **Phase.**
qualities.Traction: If an **Attack** action involving this weapon scores a number of **Successes** equal to or greater than the **Mass** rating of the **Initial** **Target,** the active Admiral may select one **Contributing** weapon with this Quality. The Initial Target immediately moves **4”** directly towards the model on which that weapon is mounted, without changing its facing. Any **Collisions** that result from this move are resolved as normal.
qualities.Triangulate: If the **Initial** **Target** of this **Attack** action is within **15”** of a friendly model with the Hydrophone *Relay* system, increase each of this weapon's **Firepower** ratings by X. Firepower ratings that do not have a value are ***not*** increased.
qualities.Voltaic: Each of this weapon's **Firepower** ratings are increased by **X** for each *System* *Failure* Critical Damage Effect the target has. Firepower ratings that do not have a value are ***not*** increased.
